outcome: Agreement in assessment of uterus diameters
Correlation in assessment of uterus diameters
cohort: The study included 100 postpartum patients from a university hospital.
finding: The study confirmed high diagnostic accuracy of portable ultrasound devices compared to standard devices, with excellent agreement in cavum assessment, promoting their use in clinical settings for early hemorrhage diagnosis.
cross-section timing: Postpartum (with subgroup analysis by day after delivery)
